caption: The drawing is circular in shape and composed of a collection of botanical and ornamental elements arranged symmetrically around the center. Inside the circle, at the center, is a landscape scene featuring tall brown trees, a round stone structure with an archway, and a golden urn placed atop a pedestal, surrounded by greenery and brownish shrubbery on a patch of green ground. Encircling the landscape, there is an elaborate border made up of various flowers, leaves, fruits, and feathers in colors such as red, pink, blue, green, and brown. Prominently, there are large red and pink roses with green leaves, blue flowers with green leaves, brown pinecones, white feathery plumes, orange and brown decorative scrolls, and small strawberry-like fruits with green tops. A brown ribbon motif runs across the lower part of the circle, linking the floral and botanical elements. The background is a light beige color, and the overall composition is enclosed within a faint circular outline.
title: Embroidered Picture
